ElectriCity API (1.0.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

HTTP API for the ElectriCity EV marketplace Express backend.

Every successful and error response uses the same envelope shape: success, status, data, and timestamp. On success, data holds the payload. On failure, data is an error object with code, message, and optional details, stack, and sentry_event_id.

Authenticate with the access_token httpOnly cookie or an Authorization: Bearer JWT. Guest carts use the X-Cart-Session header (or matching cart_session cookie). Customer and admin dashboard routes require the matching role.

Auth

Registration, login, sessions, profile, and saved addresses.

Register a new customer

Creates a customer account and returns the new profile. Tokens are not issued here. Sign in afterward to receive auth cookies.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
first_name
required
string <= 100 characters
last_name
required
string <= 100 characters
email
required
string <email>
password
required
string [ 8 .. 128 ] characters
phone_number
string or null <= 20 characters

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/auth/register

Production API

https://api.project-electricity.app/api/auth/register

Log in

Validates credentials and sets httpOnly access_token and refresh_token cookies. If a guest cart session is present, the server may merge those items into the customer cart and include cart_merge in the payload.

header Parameters
X-Cart-Session
string <uuid>

Optional guest cart session to merge on login.

Request Body schema: application/json
required
email
required
string <email>
password
required
string

Get current user

Optional auth. Guests receive data null. Authenticated callers get their User profile. Use fields to request a subset of columns.

Authorizations:
cookieAuthbearerAuth
query Parameters
fields
string
Example: fields=email,first_name

Comma-separated subset: user_id, role, first_name, last_name, email, phone_number, created_at, updated_at.

Cart

Guest or customer shopping cart. Admins cannot use cart routes.

Get cart

Returns the guest or customer cart with paginated line items. Guests must send X-Cart-Session. Authenticated admins are rejected.

Authorizations:
cookieAuthbearerAuthcartSession
query Parameters
page
integer >= 1
Default: 1
Example: page=1

Page number (1-based). Defaults to 1.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 5
Example: limit=5

Items per page. Defaults to 5. Maximum 100.

sort
string
Default: "added_at_desc"
Enum: "added_at_desc" "added_at_asc" "price_asc" "price_desc"

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/shop/cart
